## Summary

What changed and why. Link the Linear issue (for example, GOB-123).

## Testing evidence

Commands run and their results, or output showing the changed behavior. Paste the tail of `mix test` at minimum.

## Checklist

- [ ] `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` passes
- [ ] `mix format --check-formatted` passes
- [ ] `mix test` passes
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or `.env` contents are committed
